name: AZ 4533 (125 cSt)
notes: AZ 4533 (Merck/AZ), thick positive resist. Viscosity 125 cSt (25 C) and spin curve 2000-6000 rpm from the AZ 4500 series data sheet. ESTIMATED: solids content (35 wt %, interpolated by viscosity between the SDS values of AZ 5214 E and AZ 9260) and density (from the component densities). E (at 3000 rpm) is calibrated to the data sheet curve. Check solids against your own data. Calibrated at 3000 rpm: E = 0.807 um/s (Meyerhofer; also E0 of Flack), k_eta = 10.28 (Flack, n = 1), C0 = 29.4 vol %. Emslie uses h0 = 100 um and 30 s and gives the wet film after that time.
